translations.literal: Moreover their poisonous mists and malarial vapors can all harm men. Once the barbarian masses know the great army is coming, if they all clear the fields and flee far, blocking key points to wear out our army—perhaps unable to advance, with nothing to plunder on the sides, troops hungry and exhausted, disease and death—there will be a tendency to be trapped without fighting. This cannot but be deeply considered.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover their poisonous mists and malarial vapors can all harm men. Once the barbarian masses know the great army is coming, if they all clear the fields and flee far, blocking key points to wear out our army—unable to advance, with nothing to plunder on the sides, troops hungry and exhausted, disease and death—there will be a tendency to be trapped without fighting. This cannot but be deeply considered.

sentences.zh: 且自征伐倭國、占城、交趾、爪哇、緬國以來，近三十年，未嘗見有尺土一民內屬之益，計其所費錢財，死損軍數，可勝言哉！

translations.literal: Moreover since campaigns against Japan, Champa, Jiaozhi, Java, and Burma, nearly thirty years have passed without seeing the benefit of even a foot of land or one person submitting. Counting the wealth spent and soldiers killed and wounded—can it be fully told!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover since campaigns against Japan, Champa, Jiaozhi, Java, and Burma, nearly thirty years have passed without seeing the benefit of even a foot of land or one person submitting. Counting the wealth spent and soldiers killed and wounded—can it be fully told!

sentences.zh: 去歲西征，及今此舉，亦復何異。

translations.literal: Last year's western expedition and this present action—how are they different?
translations.idiomatic: Last year's western expedition and this present action—how are they different?

sentences.zh: 前鑑不遠，非難見也。

translations.literal: The warning from before is not far; it is not hard to see.
translations.idiomatic: The warning from before is not far; it is not hard to see.

sentences.zh: 軍勞民擾，未見休期，只深一人，是其禍本。

translations.literal: The army labors and the people are disturbed; no end is in sight. Shen alone is the root of this calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The army labors and the people are disturbed, with no end in sight. Shen alone is the root of this calamity.

sentences.zh: 又聞八番羅國之人，向為征西之軍擾害，捐棄生業，相繼逃叛，怨深入於骨髓，皆欲得其肉而分食之。

translations.literal: I also hear that the people of the Eight Fan and Lu states, formerly harmed by the western expedition army, abandoned their livelihoods and fled and rebelled in succession. Their resentment goes deep into the marrow; all wish to get his flesh and divide and eat it.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that the people of the Eight Fan and Lu states, formerly harmed by the western expedition army, abandoned their livelihoods and fled and rebelled in succession. Their resentment goes deep into the marrow; all wish to get his flesh and divide and eat it.

sentences.zh: 人心皆惡，天意亦憎，惟須上承天意，下順人心，早正深之罪，續下明詔，示彼一方以聖朝數十年撫養之恩，仍諭今再無遠征之役。

translations.literal: Human hearts all hate him; Heaven's intent also abhors him. One need only above accord with Heaven's intent and below follow human hearts—early punish Shen's crime, then issue a clear edict, showing that region the sage court's decades of nurturing grace, and still instruct that from now on there will be no distant expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Human hearts all hate him, and Heaven's intent also abhors him. One need only above accord with Heaven's intent and below follow human hearts—early punish Shen's crime, then issue a clear edict, showing that region the sage court's decades of nurturing grace, and instruct that from now on there will be no distant expedition.

sentences.zh: 以此招之，自有相續歸順之日，使其官民上下，皆知未須遠勞王師，與區區小丑爭一旦之勝負也。

translations.literal: With this to summon them, naturally there will be days of successive submission, making their officials and people above and below all know there is no need to far trouble the royal army to contest momentary victory or defeat with petty small foes.
translations.idiomatic: With this to summon them, there will naturally come days of successive submission, so that their officials and people above and below all know there is no need to far trouble the royal army to contest momentary victory or defeat with petty small foes.

sentences.zh: 昔大舜退師而苗氏格，充國緩戰而羌眾安，事載經傳，為萬世法。

translations.literal: Formerly Great Shun withdrew his army and the Miao submitted; Zhao Chongguo delayed battle and the Qiang masses were pacified. The matter is recorded in the classics and histories and serves as law for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Great Shun withdrew his army and the Miao submitted; Zhao Chongguo delayed battle and the Qiang were pacified. These deeds are recorded in the classics and histories and serve as a model for all ages.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，宜且駐兵近境，使其水路遠近得通，或用鹽引茶引，或用實鈔，多增米價，和市軍糧。

translations.literal: For the present plan, one should station troops near the border, allowing water routes near and far to be open; use salt certificates or tea certificates, or use real paper money, greatly increase the price of rice, and purchase military grain from the market.
translations.idiomatic: For the present plan, troops should be stationed near the border so that water routes near and far can be kept open; use salt or tea certificates, or hard currency, raise the price of rice, and purchase military grain from the market.

sentences.zh: 但法令嚴明，官不失信，可使米船蔽江而上，軍自足食，民亦不擾，內安根本，外固邊陲。

translations.literal: Only let the laws and regulations be strict and clear and officials keep faith, and rice boats can cover the river going upstream; the army will have enough to eat, the people will not be disturbed, the root within will be secure, and the border without will be firm.
translations.idiomatic: If laws and regulations are strict and clear and officials keep their word, rice boats can cover the river going upstream; the army will have enough to eat, the people will not be disturbed, the foundations at home will be secure, and the border will be firm.

sentences.zh: 以我之鎮靜，禦彼之猖狂，布恩以柔其心，畜威以制其力，期之以久，漸次服​​之。

translations.literal: With our calm to resist their arrogance, spread grace to soften their hearts, store up authority to control their strength, set a long term, and gradually make them submit.
translations.idiomatic: With our calm to resist their arrogance, spread grace to soften their hearts, store up authority to control their strength, set a long term, and gradually bring them to submission.

sentences.zh: 此王者之師，萬全之利也。

translations.literal: This is the army of a true king—the benefit of complete security.
translations.idiomatic: This is the army of a true king—the benefit of complete security.

sentences.zh: 若謂業已如此，欲罷不能，亦當慮其關係之大，審詳成敗，算定而行。

translations.literal: If one says matters have already reached this point and one wishes to stop but cannot, one should still consider how great the connection is, carefully examine success and failure, calculate and then act.
translations.idiomatic: If one says matters have already reached this point and one wishes to stop but cannot, one should still consider how great the stakes are, carefully examine success and failure, calculate and then act.

sentences.zh: 彼溪洞諸蠻，各有種類，今之相聚者，皆烏合之徒，必無久能同心敵我之理。

translations.literal: Those stream-cave barbarians each have their own kind. Those gathered now are all a rabble; there is surely no principle by which they can long remain of one heart against us.
translations.idiomatic: Those stream-cave barbarians each have their own kind. Those gathered now are all a rabble; they surely cannot long remain united against us.

sentences.zh: 但急之則相救，緩之則相疑，以計使之互相讎怨，待彼有可乘之隙，我有可動之時，徐命諸軍數道俱進。

translations.literal: Only if pressed they rescue one another; if relaxed they suspect one another. Use stratagem to make them mutually resent and hate, wait until they have a gap that can be exploited and we have a moment to move, then slowly order the armies to advance together by several routes.
translations.idiomatic: If pressed they rescue one another; if relaxed they suspect one another. Use stratagem to make them mutually resent and hate, wait until they have a gap that can be exploited and we have a moment to move, then slowly order the armies to advance together by several routes.

sentences.zh: 服從者恩之以仁，拒敵者威之以武，恩威相濟，功乃易成。

translations.literal: Those who submit—grace them with benevolence; those who resist—overawe them with force. Grace and authority assisting each other, achievement is then easy to complete.
translations.idiomatic: Those who submit—grace them with benevolence; those who resist—overawe them with force. When grace and authority assist each other, achievement comes easily.

sentences.zh: 若捨恩任威，以蹈深之覆轍，恐他日之患，有甚於今日也。

translations.literal: If one abandons grace and relies on force, treading Shen's overturned track, I fear the calamity of another day may be greater than today.
translations.idiomatic: If one abandons grace and relies on force, treading Shen's overturned track, I fear the calamity of another day may be greater than today.

sentences.zh: 不報，遂謝病去。

translations.literal: No reply came; he then resigned on grounds of illness and left.
translations.idiomatic: He received no reply and resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 七年，召拜集賢大學士，商議中書省事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he was summoned and appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Worthies to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, he was summoned and appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Worthies to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，地震，河東尤甚，詔問弭災之道。

translations.literal: In the eighth month there was an earthquake, especially severe in Hedong. An edict asked the way to quell the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month there was an earthquake, especially severe in Hedong, and an edict asked how the disaster might be quelled.

sentences.zh: 天祥上章，極言陰陽不和，天地不位，皆人事失宜所致。

translations.literal: Tianxiang submitted a memorial strongly stating that yin and yang were not in harmony and Heaven and Earth were not in their proper positions—all caused by human affairs being improper.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang submitted a memorial strongly stating that yin and yang were not in harmony and Heaven and Earth were not in their proper positions—all caused by human affairs being improperly managed.

sentences.zh: 執政者以其言切直，抑不以聞。

translations.literal: Those in power, because his words were sharp and direct, suppressed them and did not report them.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power, because his words were sharp and direct, suppressed them and did not report them to the throne.

sentences.zh: ○劉宣

translations.literal: ○ Liu Xuan
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xuan

sentences.zh: 劉宣，字伯宣，其先潞人也。

translations.literal: Liu Xuan, styled Boxuan; his ancestors were men of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xuan, styled Boxuan, was descended from men of Lu.

sentences.zh: 因出戍，留居忻，金末避地於陝，後徙太原。

translations.literal: Because they went out on garrison duty, they remained in Xin. At the end of Jin they fled to Shaanxi, and later moved to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Because they went out on garrison duty, they remained in Xin. At the end of the Jin dynasty they fled to Shaanxi and later moved to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 宣沈毅清介，居家孝友，自幼喜讀書，有經世之志。

translations.literal: Xuan was deep, resolute, pure, and upright; at home he was filial and friendly. From youth he loved reading and had the ambition to order the age.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan was deep, resolute, pure, and upright; at home he was filial and friendly. From youth he loved reading and aspired to serve the state.

sentences.zh: 宣撫張德輝至河東，見而器重之，還朝，薦為中書省掾。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Zhang Dehui came to Hedong, saw him and valued him highly. Returning to court, he recommended him as a clerk of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Pacification Commissioner Zhang Dehui came to Hedong, he saw Xuan and valued him highly. Returning to court, he recommended him as a clerk of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 宣暇則往從國子祭酒許衡講明理學。

translations.literal: In his spare time Xuan went to follow Chancellor of the Imperial Academy Xu Heng to expound Neo-Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: In his spare time Xuan studied Neo-Confucian learning under Xu Heng, Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 初命為河北河南道巡行勸農副使。

translations.literal: He was first appointed Vice Commissioner for Promoting Agriculture on Circuit Patrol of the Hebei and Henan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed Vice Commissioner for Promoting Agriculture on Circuit Patrol of the Hebei and Henan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，入為中書戶部郎中，改行省郎中。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, he entered service as Director of the Revenue Bureau of the Secretariat and was changed to Director of the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan reign, he entered service as Director of the Revenue Bureau of the Secretariat and was reassigned as Director of the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 從丞相伯顏、平章阿術統軍平江南，贊畫居多。

translations.literal: Following Chief Counselor Bayan and Vice Director Aju in commanding troops to pacify Jiangnan, he contributed greatly to planning.
translations.idiomatic: Following Chief Counselor Bayan and Vice Director Aju in commanding troops to pacify Jiangnan, he contributed greatly to planning.

sentences.zh: 伯顏嘗命宣詣闕上捷書，世祖召見，親問以南征事，應對稱旨，賜器服寵嘉之。

translations.literal: Bayan once ordered Xuan to go to court to submit a victory report. Kublai summoned him, personally questioned him on the southern campaign; his replies accorded with the emperor's intent, and he was bestowed vessels and robes in favor and praise.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan once ordered Xuan to go to court to submit a victory report. Kublai summoned him and personally questioned him about the southern campaign; his replies pleased the emperor, who bestowed vessels and robes in favor and praise.

sentences.zh: 江南平，命宣沙汰江淮冗官，其所存革，悉合公論。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan was pacified, he was ordered to sift out redundant officials of Jiang and Huai; what he retained and removed all accorded with public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan was pacified, he was ordered to sift out redundant officials of Jiang and Huai; what he retained and removed all accorded with public opinion.

sentences.zh: 除知松江府，未幾同知浙西宣慰司事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Prefect of Songjiang Prefecture; before long he became Vice Commissioner of the Zhexi Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Prefect of Songjiang Prefecture; before long he became Vice Commissioner of the Zhexi Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 在官五年，威惠並著。

translations.literal: During five years in office, his authority and kindness were both manifest.
translations.idiomatic: During five years in office, his authority and kindness were both manifest.

sentences.zh: 升江淮行省參議，擢江西湖東道提刑按察使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Counselor of the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat and elevated to Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for the Jiangxi Hudong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Counselor of the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat and elevated to Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for the Jiangxi Hudong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，入為禮部尚書，遂遷吏部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, he entered service as Minister of Rites and was then transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, he entered service as Minister of Rites and was then transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 時將伐交趾，宣上言曰：「連年日本之役，百姓愁戚，官府擾攘，今春停罷，江浙軍民歡聲如雷。

translations.literal: At the time they were about to attack Jiaozhi. Xuan memorialized: "For successive years the Japan campaign— the people were distressed and sorrowful, the government offices were in turmoil. This spring it was halted; the soldiers and people of Jiang and Zhe cheered like thunder."
translations.idiomatic: At the time they were about to attack Jiaozhi. Xuan memorialized, "For successive years the Japan campaign left the people distressed and sorrowful and the government offices in turmoil. This spring it was halted, and the soldiers and people of Jiang and Zhe cheered like thunder."

sentences.zh: 安南小邦，臣事有年，歲貢未嘗愆期，邊帥生事興兵，彼因避竄海島，使大舉無功，將士傷殘。

translations.literal: Annam is a small state that has served as subject for years; its annual tribute has never missed its term. Border commanders stirred up trouble and raised troops; they fled and hid on islands, making the great effort achieve nothing, with officers and soldiers wounded and crippled.
translations.idiomatic: Annam is a small state that has served as subject for years, and its annual tribute has never missed its term. Border commanders stirred up trouble and raised troops; the Annamese fled and hid on islands, making the great effort achieve nothing and leaving officers and soldiers wounded and crippled.

sentences.zh: 今又下令再徵，聞者莫不恐懼。

translations.literal: Now an order has again been issued for another campaign; those who hear it are all fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Now an order has again been issued for another campaign, and those who hear it are all fearful.

sentences.zh: 自古興兵，必須天時，中原平土，猶避盛夏，交廣炎瘴之地，毒氣害人，甚於兵刃。

translations.literal: From antiquity when raising troops one must have Heaven's seasons. Even on the level land of the central plains one still avoids midsummer; Jiao and Guang are lands of malarial heat and poisonous vapors—poisonous air harms men more than weapons.
translations.idiomatic: From antiquity when raising troops one must heed Heaven's seasons. Even on the level land of the central plains one still avoids midsummer; Jiao and Guang are lands of malarial heat and poisonous vapors, and poisonous air harms men more than weapons.

sentences.zh: 今以七月，會諸道兵於靜江，比至安南，病死必眾，緩急遇敵，何以應之？

translations.literal: Now in the seventh month troops from all circuits are assembled at Jingjiang; by the time they reach Annam, deaths from disease will surely be many. In urgency or calm, meeting the enemy—how can one respond?
translations.idiomatic: Now in the seventh month troops from all circuits are assembled at Jingjiang; by the time they reach Annam, deaths from disease will surely be many. In urgency or calm, meeting the enemy—how can one respond?

sentences.zh: 又交趾無糧，水路難通，無車馬牛畜馱載，不免陸運。

translations.literal: Moreover Jiaozhi has no grain; water routes are hard to open; there are no carts, horses, oxen, or pack animals for transport—land transport cannot be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Jiaozhi has no grain; water routes are hard to open; there are no carts, horses, oxen, or pack animals for transport, so land transport cannot be avoided.

sentences.zh: 一夫擔米五斗，往還自食外，官得其半；

translations.literal: One man carries five dou of rice; going and returning, apart from his own food, the government gets half;
translations.idiomatic: One man carries five dou of rice; going and returning, apart from his own food, the government gets half;

sentences.zh: 若十萬石，用四十萬人，止可供一二月。

translations.literal: if one hundred thousand shi, four hundred thousand men are used—it can supply only one or two months.
translations.idiomatic: for one hundred thousand shi, four hundred thousand men are needed—it can supply only one or two months.

sentences.zh: 軍糧搬載，船料軍須，通用五六十萬眾。

translations.literal: Transporting military grain, ship materials, and military supplies—in all five or six hundred thousand people are needed.
translations.idiomatic: Transporting military grain, ship materials, and military supplies would require five or six hundred thousand people in all.

sentences.zh: 廣西、湖南調度頻數，民多離散，戶令供役，亦不能辦。

translations.literal: Guangxi and Hunan are frequently requisitioned; the people are mostly scattered and dispersed. Even household orders for corvée cannot be fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi and Hunan are frequently requisitioned; the people are mostly scattered and dispersed. Even household orders for corvée cannot be fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 況湖廣密邇，溪洞寇盜常多，萬一奸人伺隙，大兵一出，乘虛生變，雖有留後，人馬疲弱衰老，卒難應變。

translations.literal: Moreover Huguang is close at hand; stream-cave bandits are often numerous. If by chance wicked men watch for an opening, once the great army goes out they seize the void and rebellion arises. Though there are rear guards, men and horses are weak, exhausted, and aged—it will be hard to respond to change.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Huguang is close at hand and stream-cave bandits are often numerous. If wicked men watch for an opening, once the great army goes out they may seize the moment and rebellion may arise. Though there are rear guards, men and horses are weak, exhausted, and aged, and it will be hard to respond to change.

sentences.zh: 何不與彼中軍官深知事體者，論量萬全方略，不然，將復蹈前轍矣。

translations.literal: Why not discuss and weigh a completely secure strategy with military officers there who deeply know the situation? Otherwise, one will again tread the former track.
translations.idiomatic: Why not discuss and weigh a completely secure strategy with military officers there who deeply know the situation? Otherwise, one will again tread the former track.

sentences.zh: 」及再徵日本，宣又​​上言，其略曰：「近議復置征東行省，再興日本之師，此役不息，安危系焉。

translations.literal: " When Japan was again attacked, Xuan again memorialized. The gist was: "Recently it was proposed to re-establish the Eastern Expedition Branch Secretariat and again raise troops against Japan. If this campaign does not cease, security and danger depend on it."
translations.idiomatic: When Japan was again attacked, Xuan again memorialized. The gist was, "Recently it was proposed to re-establish the Eastern Expedition Branch Secretariat and again raise troops against Japan. If this campaign does not cease, the state's security and danger depend on it."

sentences.zh: 唆都建伐占城，海牙言平交趾，三數年間，湖廣、江西供給船隻、軍須糧運，官民大擾，廣東群盜並起，軍兵遠涉江海瘴毒之地，死傷過半，即日連兵未解。

translations.literal: Sodu proposed attacking Champa; Haiya spoke of pacifying Jiaozhi. Within three or four years Huguang and Jiangxi supplied ships, military supplies, and grain transport; officials and people were greatly disturbed; bandit gangs rose together in Guangdong; soldiers and troops went far through river and sea lands of malarial poison—over half died and were wounded; even now connected campaigns have not ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Sodu proposed attacking Champa; Haiya spoke of pacifying Jiaozhi. Within three or four years Huguang and Jiangxi supplied ships, military supplies, and grain transport; officials and people were greatly disturbed; bandit gangs rose together in Guangdong; soldiers went far through river and sea lands of malarial poison, and over half died or were wounded; even now connected campaigns have not ceased.

sentences.zh: 且交趾與我接境，蕞爾小邦，遣親王提兵深入，未見報功，唆都為賊所殺，自遺羞辱。

translations.literal: Moreover Jiaozhi borders us—a tiny small state. Sending an imperial prince to lead troops deep in, no merit was reported; Sodu was killed by bandits, bringing shame on himself.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Jiaozhi borders us—a tiny state. Sending an imperial prince to lead troops deep into its territory brought no reported merit; Sodu was killed by bandits, bringing shame on himself.

sentences.zh: 況日本海洋萬里，疆土闊遠，非二國可比。

translations.literal: Moreover Japan lies ten thousand li across the ocean; its territory is broad and distant—not comparable to those two states.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Japan lies ten thousand li across the ocean; its territory is broad and distant—not comparable to those two states.

sentences.zh: 今次出師，動眾履險，縱不遇風，可到彼岸，倭國地廣，徒眾猥多，彼兵四集，我師無援，萬一不利，欲發救兵，其能飛渡耶？

translations.literal: This present expedition moves masses through danger. Even if no wind is encountered and one can reach the other shore—Japan's land is broad, its followers numerous and disorderly; their troops gather on four sides, our army has no support. If by chance things go badly and one wishes to send rescue troops—can they fly across?
translations.idiomatic: This present expedition moves masses through danger. Even if no wind is encountered and one can reach the other shore—Japan's land is broad and its followers numerous and disorderly; their troops gather on four sides while our army has no support. If things go badly and one wishes to send rescue troops—can they fly across?

sentences.zh: 隋伐高麗，三次大舉，數見敗北，喪師百萬。

translations.literal: Sui attacked Goryeo with three great efforts, repeatedly suffered defeat, and lost armies of a million.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui attacked Goryeo with three great efforts, repeatedly suffered defeat, and lost armies of a million.

sentences.zh: 唐太宗以英武自負，親征高麗，雖取數城而還，徒增追悔。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong of Tang, confident in his martial prowess, personally campaigned against Goryeo; though he took several cities and returned, he only added regret.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong of Tang, confident in his martial prowess, personally campaigned against Goryeo; though he took several cities and returned, he only added to his regret.

sentences.zh: 且高麗平壤諸城，皆居陸地，去中原不遠，以二國之眾加之，尚不能克，況日本僻在海隅，與中國相懸萬里哉！

translations.literal: Moreover Goryeo's Pyongyang and other cities all lie on land, not far from the central plains; with the masses of two states added, still they could not be conquered—how much less Japan, remote in a corner of the sea, separated from China by ten thousand li!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Goryeo's Pyongyang and other cities all lie on land, not far from the central plains; with the masses of two states added, still they could not be conquered—how much less Japan, remote in a corner of the sea, separated from China by ten thousand li!

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納其言。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised and accepted his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted his words.

sentences.zh: 二十三年十二月，中書傳旨，議更鈔用錢，宣獻議曰：「原交鈔所起，漢、唐以來，皆未嘗有。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twenty-third year, the Secretariat transmitted an edict to discuss changing paper money and using coin. Xuan submitted his opinion: "Originally paper money arose—since Han and Tang, there never was such a thing."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twenty-third year, the Secretariat transmitted an edict to discuss changing paper money and using coin. Xuan submitted his opinion, "Originally paper money arose—since Han and Tang, there never was such a thing."

sentences.zh: 宋紹興初，軍餉不繼，造此以誘商旅，為沿邊糶買之計，比銅錢易於齎擎，​​民甚便之。

translations.literal: In the early Shaoxing period of Song, military pay could not continue; this was created to entice merchants and travelers, as a plan for border grain purchase. Compared with copper cash it was easier to carry; the people found it very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shaoxing period of Song, military pay could not continue; paper money was created to entice merchants and travelers as a plan for border grain purchase. Compared with copper cash it was easier to carry, and the people found it very convenient.

sentences.zh: 稍有滯礙，即用見錢，尚存古人子母相權之意。

translations.literal: When there was slight obstruction, hard cash was immediately used—still preserving the ancient idea of parent and child mutually balancing.
translations.idiomatic: When there was slight obstruction, hard cash was immediately used, still preserving the ancient idea of parent and child currencies mutually balancing.

sentences.zh: 日增月益，其法浸弊，欲求目前速效，未見良策。

translations.literal: Day by day it increased, month by month it grew; the method gradually decayed. Seeking quick effect before one's eyes, no good plan is seen.
translations.idiomatic: Day by day it increased and month by month it grew until the method gradually decayed. Seeking quick effect before one's eyes, no good plan is seen.

sentences.zh: 新鈔必欲創造，用權舊鈔，只是改換名目，無金銀作本稱提，軍國支用，不復抑損，三數年後亦如元寶矣。

translations.literal: If new notes must be created, using old notes as weight is only changing names. Without gold and silver as backing for redemption, military and state expenditures are not reduced—in three or four years they will be like the Yuanbao notes.
translations.idiomatic: If new notes must be created, using old notes as weight is only changing names. Without gold and silver as backing for redemption, military and state expenditures are not reduced—in three or four years they will be like the Yuanbao notes.

sentences.zh: 宋、金之弊，足為殷鑑。

translations.literal: The failures of Song and Jin are sufficient warning.
translations.idiomatic: The failures of Song and Jin are sufficient warning.

sentences.zh: 鑄造銅錢，又當詳究。

translations.literal: Casting copper cash should also be thoroughly investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Casting copper cash should also be thoroughly investigated.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢、隋、唐、金、宋利病，著在史策，不待縷陳。

translations.literal: The benefits and harms of Qin, Han, Sui, Tang, Jin, and Song are recorded in historical annals; they need not be listed in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The benefits and harms of Qin, Han, Sui, Tang, Jin, and Song are recorded in historical annals and need not be listed in detail.

sentences.zh: 國朝廢錢已久，一旦行之，功費不貲，非為遠計。

translations.literal: Our dynasty has abolished coin long ago; to implement it at once would cost immeasurable effort and is not a plan for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty has abolished coin long ago; to implement it at once would cost immeasurable effort and is not a plan for the long term.

sentences.zh: 大抵利民權物，其要自不妄用始，若欲濟丘壑之用，非惟鑄造不敷，抑亦不久自弊矣。

translations.literal: Generally speaking, to benefit the people and balance goods, the key begins with not using recklessly. If one wishes to fill the ravines and gullies of expenditure, not only will casting not suffice—it will soon decay on its own.
translations.idiomatic: Generally speaking, to benefit the people and balance goods, the key begins with not using recklessly. If one wishes to fill the bottomless pits of expenditure, not only will casting not suffice—it will soon decay on its own.

sentences.zh: 」屬桑哥謀立尚書省，以專國柄，錢議遂罷。

translations.literal: " Just then Sangge plotted to establish the Ministry to monopolize state power; the coin discussion was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Sangge plotted to establish the Ministry to monopolize state power, and the coin discussion was dropped.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，由集賢學士除行台御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, from Academician of the Hall of Worthies he was appointed Supervising Censor-in-Chief of the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, from Academician of the Hall of Worthies he was appointed Supervising Censor-in-Chief of the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時江浙行省丞相忙古台悍戾縱恣，常慮台臣糾言其罪，而尤忌宣。

translations.literal: At the time the Chief Counselor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, Manggotai, was fierce, perverse, and unrestrained. He constantly feared that censorial officials would impeach his crimes, and especially hated Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Chief Counselor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, Manggotai, was fierce, perverse, and unrestrained. He constantly feared that censorial officials would impeach his crimes, and especially hated Xuan.

sentences.zh: 一日，御史大夫與中丞出建康城，點視軍船，群御史從。

translations.literal: One day the Supervising Censor-in-Chief and the Censor-in-Chief went out of Jiankang city to inspect military ships; the censors all followed.
translations.idiomatic: One day the Supervising Censor-in-Chief and the Censor-in-Chief went out of Jiankang city to inspect military ships, and the censors all followed.

sentences.zh: 有以軍船載葦者，御史張諒詰之，知為行省官所使，詣揚州覆實。

translations.literal: Someone was using military ships to carry reeds. Censor Zhang Liang questioned this and learned they were sent by Branch Secretariat officials; he went to Yangzhou to verify.
translations.idiomatic: Someone was using military ships to carry reeds. Censor Zhang Liang questioned this and learned they were sent by Branch Secretariat officials; he went to Yangzhou to verify.

sentences.zh: 忙古台盛怒，即圖報復。

translations.literal: Manggotai was furious and immediately plotted revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Manggotai was furious and immediately plotted revenge.

sentences.zh: 時大夫之父，官於屬郡，隨被按劾。

translations.literal: At the time the Supervising Censor's father held office in a subordinate prefecture and was immediately impeached and investigated.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Supervising Censor's father held office in a subordinate prefecture and was immediately impeached and investigated.

sentences.zh: 遣其黨造建康，伺台中違失，台官皆竦懼，陰往懇求自解，惟宣屹然不動。

translations.literal: He sent his followers to Jiankang to watch for violations in the censorate; the censorial officials were all fearful and secretly went to plead for self-exoneration—only Xuan stood firm unmoved.
translations.idiomatic: He sent his followers to Jiankang to watch for violations in the censorate; the censorial officials were all fearful and secretly went to plead for self-exoneration—only Xuan stood firm unmoved.

sentences.zh: 忙古台怨宣愈甚，羅織宣之子，系揚州獄。

translations.literal: Manggotai hated Xuan all the more, fabricated charges against Xuan's son, and imprisoned him in Yangzhou jail.
translations.idiomatic: Manggotai hated Xuan all the more, fabricated charges against Xuan's son, and imprisoned him in Yangzhou jail.

sentences.zh: 又令建康酒務、淘金等官及錄事司官以罪免者，誣告行台沮壞錢糧，以聞於朝，必欲置宣死地。

translations.literal: He also had dismissed officials of the Jiankang wine bureau, gold-panning bureau, and record office falsely accuse the Branch Secretariat of obstructing and damaging funds and grain, reporting to court—determined to bring Xuan to death.
translations.idiomatic: He also had dismissed officials of the Jiankang wine bureau, gold-panning bureau, and record office falsely accuse the Branch Secretariat of obstructing and damaging funds and grain, reporting to court—determined to bring Xuan to death.

sentences.zh: 朝廷為遣官二員，置獄於行省，鞫問其事。

translations.literal: The court therefore dispatched two officials and established a prison at the Branch Secretariat to interrogate the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The court therefore dispatched two officials and established a prison at the Branch Secretariat to interrogate the matter.

sentences.zh: 宣及御史六人俱就逮。

translations.literal: Xuan and six censors were all arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan and six censors were all arrested.

sentences.zh: 既登舟，行省以軍船列兵衛驅迫之，至則分異各處，不使往來。

translations.literal: After boarding the boat, the Branch Secretariat used military ships arrayed with guards to drive and press them. When they arrived they were separated to different places and not allowed to communicate.
translations.idiomatic: After boarding the boat, the Branch Secretariat used military ships arrayed with guards to drive and press them. When they arrived they were separated to different places and not allowed to communicate.

sentences.zh: 九月朔，宣自剄於舟中。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, Xuan cut his own throat in the boat.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, Xuan cut his own throat in the boat.

sentences.zh: 始宣將行時，書後事緘付從子自誠，令勿啟視。

translations.literal: When Xuan was about to depart, he wrote his final affairs, sealed them, and gave them to his nephew Zicheng, ordering him not to open and look.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuan was about to depart, he wrote his final affairs, sealed them, and gave them to his nephew Zicheng, ordering him not to open them.

sentences.zh: 宣死，視其書，辭云：「觸怒大臣，誣構成罪，豈能與經斷小人交口辯訟，屈膝為容於怨家之前。

translations.literal: After Xuan died, they looked at his writing. The text said: "Having offended a great minister and been falsely framed into guilt, how could I cross words in argument with petty men tried by law, bow the knee and make a show before my enemy's family?"
translations.idiomatic: After Xuan died, they looked at his writing. The text said, "Having offended a great minister and been falsely framed into guilt, how could I cross words in argument with petty men tried by law, bow the knee and make a show before my enemy's family?"

sentences.zh: 身為台臣，義不受辱，當自引決，但不獲以身殉國為恨耳。

translations.literal: As a censorial official, by duty I cannot accept disgrace; I should take my own life—only that I could not die for the state is my regret.
translations.idiomatic: As a censorial official, by duty I cannot accept disgrace; I should take my own life—only that I could not die for the state is my regret.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 天乎！

translations.literal: Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: Heaven!

sentences.zh: 實鑑此心。

translations.literal: Truly witness this heart.
translations.idiomatic: Truly witness this heart.

sentences.zh: 」且別有公文言忙古台罪狀，後得其稿，塗注勾抹，辭句難辨。

translations.literal: " Moreover there was a separate official document stating Manggotai's crimes. Later his draft was obtained; with emendations, check marks, and deletions, the words were hard to distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover there was a separate official document stating Manggotai's crimes. Later his draft was obtained; with emendations, check marks, and deletions, the words were hard to distinguish.

sentences.zh: 前治書侍御史霍肅為敘次其文，讀者悲憤。

translations.literal: Former Investigating Censor Huo Su arranged and ordered his text; readers were grieved and indignant.
translations.idiomatic: Former Investigating Censor Huo Su arranged and ordered his text; readers were grieved and indignant.

sentences.zh: 宣既引決，行省白於朝，以為宣知罪重自殺。

translations.literal: After Xuan had taken his own life, the Branch Secretariat reported to court that Xuan knew his guilt was heavy and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: After Xuan had taken his own life, the Branch Secretariat reported to court that Xuan knew his guilt was heavy and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 前後構成其事者，郎中張斯立也。

translations.literal: The one who from beginning to end fabricated this affair was Director Zhang Sili.
translations.idiomatic: The one who from beginning to end fabricated this affair was Director Zhang Sili.

sentences.zh: 然宣忠義節操，為世所重，聞者莫不嗟悼。

translations.literal: Yet Xuan's loyalty, righteousness, and integrity were valued by the age; those who heard were all sighing in grief.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Xuan's loyalty, righteousness, and integrity were valued by the age; those who heard were all sighing in grief.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年，從子自持上宣行實，御史臺以聞，制贈資善大夫、御史中丞、上護軍，追封彭城郡公，諡忠憲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yanyou, his nephew Zichi submitted Xuan's conduct and deeds; the Censorate reported to court. By decree he was posthumously granted Zishan Doctor, Supervising Censor-in-Chief, and Senior Guardian General, ennobled as Duke of Pengcheng Commandery with the posthumous name Zhongxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Yanyou reign, his nephew Zichi submitted Xuan's conduct and deeds; the Censorate reported to court. By decree he was posthumously granted Zishan Doctor, Supervising Censor-in-Chief, and Senior Guardian General, ennobled as Duke of Pengcheng Commandery with the posthumous name Zhongxian.

sentences.zh: ○何榮祖

translations.literal: ○ He Rongzu
translations.idiomatic: He Rongzu

sentences.zh: 何榮祖，字繼先，其先太原人。

translations.literal: He Rongzu, styled Jixian; his ancestors were men of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He Rongzu, styled Jixian, was descended from men of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 父瑛，金貞祐間試文法入優等，補吏，後授明威將軍，守鉅鹿尹，權軍器監主事。

translations.literal: His father Ying, during the Zhenyou period of Jin, tested in literary law and entered the superior grade, was appointed clerk, and later was granted Bright Authority General, served as Administrator of Julu, and acted as Chief Clerk of the Military Equipment Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ying, during the Zhenyou period of Jin, tested in literary law and entered the superior grade, was appointed clerk, and later was granted Bright Authority General, served as Administrator of Julu, and acted as Chief Clerk of the Military Equipment Directorate.

sentences.zh: 金亡，徙家廣平。

translations.literal: When Jin fell, the family moved to Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin fell, the family moved to Guangping.

sentences.zh: 榮祖狀貌魁偉，額有赤文如雙樹，背負隆起。

translations.literal: Rongzu's appearance was tall and imposing; on his forehead was red marking like twin trees; his back humped upward.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu was tall and imposing; on his forehead was a red mark like twin trees, and his back humped upward.

sentences.zh: 有相者謂曰：「子位極人臣，且壽相也。

translations.literal: A physiognomist said to him: "You will reach the highest rank among men and also have the physiognomy of long life."
translations.idiomatic: A physiognomist said to him, "You will reach the highest rank among men and also have the physiognomy of long life."

sentences.zh: 」何氏世業吏，榮祖尤所通習，遂以吏累遷中書省掾，擢御史臺都事。

translations.literal: " The He family had clerkship as hereditary occupation; Rongzu was especially versed in it. He therefore rose through clerk posts to clerk of the Secretariat and was promoted to Chief Clerk of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: The He family had clerkship as a hereditary occupation, and Rongzu was especially versed in it. He therefore rose through clerk posts to clerk of the Secretariat and was promoted to Chief Clerk of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 始折節讀書，日記數千言。

translations.literal: He then restrained himself to read books, recording several thousand words daily.
translations.idiomatic: He then applied himself to reading books, recording several thousand words daily.

sentences.zh: 阿合馬方用事，置總庫於其家，以收四方之利，號曰和市。

translations.literal: Ahmad was then in power; he established a general treasury in his home to collect profits from all directions, called Harmonious Market.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad was then in power; he established a general treasury in his home to collect profits from all directions, called Harmonious Market.

sentences.zh: 監察御史範方等斥其非，論甚力。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Fan Fang and others denounced its wrongness and argued very forcefully.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Fan Fang and others denounced its wrongness and argued very forcefully.

sentences.zh: 阿合馬知榮祖主其謀，奏為左右司都事以隸己。

translations.literal: Ahmad knew Rongzu had masterminded this and memorialized to appoint him Chief Clerk of the Left and Right Offices to subordinate him to himself.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad knew Rongzu had masterminded this and memorialized to appoint him Chief Clerk of the Left and Right Offices to subordinate him to himself.

sentences.zh: 未幾，御史臺除治書侍御史，升侍御史，又出為山東按察使，而阿合馬莫逞其志矣。

translations.literal: Before long the Censorate appointed him Investigating Censor, promoted him to Attending Censor, and then sent him out as Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for Shandong—and Ahmad could no longer carry out his intent.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Censorate appointed him Investigating Censor, promoted him to Attending Censor, and then sent him out as Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for Shandong—and Ahmad could no longer carry out his intent.

sentences.zh: 有帖木剌思者，以貪墨為僉事李唐卿所劾。

translations.literal: There was one Temür Si who was impeached for embezzlement by Commissioner Li Tangqing.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Temür Si who was impeached for embezzlement by Commissioner Li Tangqing.

sentences.zh: 帖木剌思計無所出，適濟南有上變告者，唐卿察其妄，取訟牒焚之。

translations.literal: Temür Si could think of no way out. Just then in Jinan there was one who reported a rebellion; Tangqing saw it was false, took the lawsuit documents and burned them.
translations.idiomatic: Temür Si could think of no way out. Just then in Jinan someone reported a rebellion; Tangqing saw it was false, took the lawsuit documents, and burned them.

sentences.zh: 帖木剌思乃摭取為辭，告唐卿縱反者，逮係數十人。

translations.literal: Temür Si then picked out phrases to make a case and accused Tangqing of releasing rebels; several dozen people were arrested and bound.
translations.idiomatic: Temür Si then picked out phrases to make a case and accused Tangqing of releasing rebels; several dozen people were arrested and bound.

sentences.zh: 獄久不決，詔榮祖與左丞郝禎、參政耿仁傑鞫之。

translations.literal: The case long went unresolved. An edict ordered Rongzu, together with Left Director Hao Zhen and Vice Director Geng Renjie, to try it.
translations.idiomatic: The case long went unresolved. An edict ordered Rongzu, together with Left Director Hao Zhen and Vice Director Geng Renjie, to try it.

sentences.zh: 榮祖得其情，欲抵告者罪。

translations.literal: Rongzu got the facts and wished to punish the accuser.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu got the facts and wished to punish the accuser.

sentences.zh: 禎、仁傑議以失口亂言之罪坐之，榮祖不可。

translations.literal: Zhen and Renjie proposed to punish him with the crime of loose speech and disorderly words; Rongzu would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen and Renjie proposed to punish him with the crime of loose speech and disorderly words; Rongzu would not agree.

sentences.zh: 俄遷河南按察使，二執政竟以失口亂言杖其人，而株連者俱得釋，唐卿之誣遂白。

translations.literal: Soon Rongzu was transferred to Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for Henan. The two administrators ultimately beat the man for loose speech and disorderly words; those implicated were all released, and Tangqing's false accusation was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Rongzu was transferred to Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for Henan. The two administrators ultimately beat the man for loose speech and disorderly words; those implicated were all released, and Tangqing's false accusation was cleared.

sentences.zh: 平涼府言有南人二十餘輩叛歸江南，安西行省欲上聞，會榮祖來為參政，止之曰：「何必上聞朝廷，此輩去者皆人奴耳，今聞江南平，遁往求其家，移文召捕之可也。

translations.literal: Pingliang Prefecture reported that over twenty southerners had rebelled and returned to Jiangnan. The Anxi Branch Secretariat wished to report to court. When Rongzu came as Vice Director, he stopped them: "Why must this be reported to court? Those who left are all human slaves. Now hearing Jiangnan is pacified, they fled to seek their families—send documents to summon and capture them."
translations.idiomatic: Pingliang Prefecture reported that over twenty southerners had rebelled and returned to Jiangnan. The Anxi Branch Secretariat wished to report to court. When Rongzu came as Vice Director, he stopped them, saying, "Why must this be reported to court? Those who left are all human slaves. Now hearing Jiangnan is pacified, they fled to seek their families—send documents to summon and capture them."

sentences.zh: 」已而逃者俱獲，果人奴也，治以本罪而付其主。

translations.literal: " Before long the fugitives were all captured; they were indeed human slaves, punished according to their original crime and returned to their masters.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the fugitives were all captured; they were indeed human slaves, punished according to their original crime and returned to their masters.

sentences.zh: 其於事明決多類此。

translations.literal: In affairs he was clear and decisive—mostly like this.
translations.idiomatic: In affairs he was clear and decisive—mostly like this.

sentences.zh: 除雲南行省參知政事，以母老辭。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat but declined on grounds of his mother's age.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Director of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat but declined on grounds of his mother's age.

sentences.zh: 又拜御史中丞，復出為山東東西道按察使。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Supervising Censor-in-Chief and sent out as Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for the Shandong East and West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed Supervising Censor-in-Chief and sent out as Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for the Shandong East and West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時宣慰使樂實、姚演開膠州海道，有制禁戢諸人沮撓，糧舶遇暴風多漂覆。

translations.literal: At the time Pacification Commissioners Yue Shi and Yao Yan opened the Jiaozhou sea route. There was a regulation forbidding anyone to obstruct and hinder; grain ships encountering violent winds were often washed away and capsized.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Pacification Commissioners Yue Shi and Yao Yan opened the Jiaozhou sea route. There was a regulation forbidding anyone to obstruct and hinder; grain ships encountering violent winds were often washed away and capsized.

sentences.zh: 樂實弗信，督諸漕卒償之，搒掠慘毒，自殺者相繼。

translations.literal: Yue Shi did not believe this and pressed the transport laborers to compensate; beating and plundering were cruel and poisonous, and suicides followed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Shi did not believe this and pressed the transport laborers to compensate; beating and plundering were cruel and poisonous, and suicides followed one after another.

sentences.zh: 按察官懼違制，莫敢言。

translations.literal: The investigation officials feared violating the regulation and none dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: The investigation officials feared violating the regulation and none dared speak.

sentences.zh: 榮祖曰：「第言之，若朝廷見譴，吾自當之。

translations.literal: Rongzu said: "Just speak of it. If the court reproaches us, I will take responsibility myself."
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu said, "Just speak of it. If the court reproaches us, I will take responsibility myself."

sentences.zh: 」即草辭以奏，詔免其徵。

translations.literal: " He immediately drafted a memorial and submitted it; an edict exempted the levy.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately drafted a memorial and submitted it; an edict exempted the levy.

sentences.zh: 召入為尚書參知政事。

translations.literal: He was summoned to serve as Vice Director of the Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as Vice Director of the Ministry.

sentences.zh: 時桑哥專政，亟於理算錢穀，人受其害。

translations.literal: At the time Sangge monopolized government and urgently pursued auditing of funds and grain; people suffered from it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Sangge monopolized government and urgently pursued auditing of funds and grain; people suffered from it.

sentences.zh: 榮祖請罷之，帝不從，屢懇請不已，乃稍緩之。

translations.literal: Rongzu requested its abolition; the emperor did not agree. He repeatedly pleaded without cease, and it was then slightly relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu requested its abolition; the emperor did not agree. He repeatedly pleaded without cease, and it was then slightly relaxed.

sentences.zh: 而畿內民苦尤甚，榮祖每以為辭。

translations.literal: But the people's suffering within the capital region was especially severe; Rongzu often used this as his argument.
translations.idiomatic: But the people's suffering within the capital region was especially severe; Rongzu often used this as his argument.

sentences.zh: 同僚曰：「上既為免諸路，惟未及在京，可少止勿言也。

translations.literal: Colleagues said: "The emperor has already exempted the circuits; only the capital has not been included. You could stop speaking for a while."
translations.idiomatic: Colleagues said, "The emperor has already exempted the circuits; only the capital has not been included. You could stop speaking for a while."

sentences.zh: 」榮祖執愈堅，至於忤旨不少屈，竟不署其牘。

translations.literal: " Rongzu held all the more firmly, even opposing the imperial intent without the slightest yielding, and ultimately would not sign the documents.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu held all the more firmly, even opposing the imperial intent without the slightest yielding, and ultimately would not sign the documents.

sentences.zh: 未踰月，而害民之弊皆聞，帝乃思榮祖言，召問所宜。

translations.literal: Within a month the harms to the people were all heard; the emperor then thought of Rongzu's words and summoned him to ask what should be done.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month the harms to the people were all heard; the emperor then thought of Rongzu's words and summoned him to ask what should be done.

sentences.zh: 榮祖請於歲終立局考校，人以為便，立為常式，詔賜以鈔萬一千貫。

translations.literal: Rongzu requested establishing an office at year's end for examination and verification; people thought it convenient. It was established as a regular practice, and an edict bestowed eleven thousand strings of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu requested establishing an office at year's end for examination and verification; people thought it convenient. It was established as a regular practice, and an edict bestowed eleven thousand strings of paper money.

sentences.zh: 榮祖條中外有官規程，欲矯時敝，桑哥抑不為通。

translations.literal: Rongzu itemized regulations for officials within and without, wishing to correct the abuses of the age; Sangge suppressed them and would not transmit them.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu itemized regulations for officials within and without, wishing to correct the abuses of the age; Sangge suppressed them and would not transmit them.

sentences.zh: 榮祖既與之異議，乃以病告，特授集賢大學士。

translations.literal: Rongzu, having disagreed with him, then reported illness and was specially granted Grand Academician of the Hall of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzu, having disagreed with him, then reported illness and was specially granted Grand Academician of the Hall of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 未幾，起為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Before long he was recalled as Right Director of the Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was recalled as Right Director of the Ministry.

sentences.zh: 桑哥敗，改中書右丞。

translations.literal: When Sangge fell, he was changed to Right Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Sangge fell, he was changed to Right Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 奏行所定《至元新格》，請改提刑按察司為肅政廉訪司，而立監治之法。

translations.literal: He memorialized to implement the established New Regulations of the Zhiyuan reign, requested changing the Commission for the Investigation of Crimes to the Commission for Rectifying Governance and Investigating Corruption, and established methods of supervisory governance.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to implement the established New Regulations of the Zhiyuan reign, requested changing the Commission for the Investigation of Crimes to the Commission for Rectifying Governance and Investigating Corruption, and established methods of supervisory governance.

sentences.zh: 又上言：「國家用度不可不足，天下百姓不可不安。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "State expenditures cannot be insufficient; the common people under Heaven cannot be insecure."
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized, "State expenditures cannot be insufficient; the common people under Heaven cannot be insecure."

sentences.zh: 今理財者弗顧民力之困，言治者弗圖國計之大。

translations.literal: Now those who manage wealth do not consider the people's labor exhausted; those who speak of governance do not plan for the state's great accounting.
translations.idiomatic: Now those who manage wealth do not consider the people's labor exhausted; those who speak of governance do not plan for the state's great accounting.

sentences.zh: 且當用之人恆多，而得用之人恆少。

translations.literal: Moreover those who ought to be used are always many, while those who can be used are always few.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover those who ought to be used are always many, while those who can be used are always few.

sentences.zh: 要之，省部實為根本，必擇材而用之。

translations.literal: In sum, the secretariat and ministries are truly the root; one must select talent and use it.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, the secretariat and ministries are truly the root; one must select talent and use it.

sentences.zh: 按察司雖監臨一道，其職在於除蠹弊、安斯民，苟有弗至，則省台又當遣官體察之，庶有所益。

translations.literal: Though the Commission for the Investigation of Crimes supervises a circuit, its duty is to remove corruption and secure the people. If it falls short, the secretariat and censorate should again dispatch officials to investigate on the spot—perhaps there will be some benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Though the Commission for the Investigation of Crimes supervises a circuit, its duty is to remove corruption and secure the people. If it falls short, the secretariat and censorate should again dispatch officials to investigate on the spot—perhaps there will be some benefit.

sentences.zh: 」帝深然之。

translations.literal: " The emperor deeply agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply agreed.

sentences.zh: 屢以老疾乞解機務，詔免署事，惟預議中書而食其祿。

translations.literal: He repeatedly begged to be relieved of key affairs on grounds of age and illness. An edict exempted him from signing documents; he only participated in Secretariat deliberation and received his salary.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly begged to be relieved of key affairs on grounds of age and illness. An edict exempted him from signing documents; he only participated in Secretariat deliberation and received his salary.

sentences.zh: 尋拜昭文館大學士，預中書省事，又加平章政事。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Exalted Literature, participated in Secretariat affairs, and was further made Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Exalted Literature, participated in Secretariat affairs, and was further made Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 以水旱請罷，不允。

translations.literal: On grounds of flood and drought he requested dismissal; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On grounds of flood and drought he requested dismissal; it was not granted.

sentences.zh: 先是，榮祖奉旨定《大德律令》，書成已久，至是乃得請於上，詔元老大臣聚聽之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Rongzu had received an edict to compile the Statutes and Commands of the Dade reign; the book had been completed long ago. Only now was he able to request approval from the throne; an edict ordered senior ministers to gather and hear it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Rongzu had received an edict to compile the Statutes and Commands of the Dade reign; the book had been completed long ago. Only now was he able to request approval from the throne; an edict ordered senior ministers to gather and hear it.

sentences.zh: 未及頒行，適子秘書少監惠沒，遂歸廣平，卒，年七十九。

translations.literal: Before it could be promulgated, his son Hui, Vice Director of the Secretariat, died. He then returned to Guangping and died, aged seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: Before it could be promulgated, his son Hui, Vice Director of the Secretariat, died. He then returned to Guangping and died, aged seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 贈光祿大夫、大司徒、柱國，追封趙國公，諡文憲。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand Minister of Education, and Pillar of the State, ennobled as Duke of Zhao with the posthumous name Wenxian.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand Minister of Education, and Pillar of the State, ennobled as Duke of Zhao with the posthumous name Wenxian.

sentences.zh: 榮祖身至大官，而僦第以居，飲器用青瓷杯。

translations.literal: Though Rongzu reached high office, he rented a residence to live in and used celadon cups for drinking vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Though Rongzu reached high office, he rented a residence to live in and used celadon cups for drinking vessels.

sentences.zh: 中宮聞之，賜以上尊，及金五十兩、銀五百兩、鈔二萬五千貫，俾置器買宅，以旌其廉。

translations.literal: The empress heard of this and bestowed fine wine, as well as fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and twenty-five thousand strings of paper money, ordering him to buy vessels and a residence, to honor his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: The empress heard of this and bestowed fine wine, as well as fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and twenty-five thousand strings of paper money, ordering him to buy vessels and a residence to honor his integrity.

sentences.zh: 所著書，有《大畜》十集，又有《學易記》、《載道集》、《觀物外篇》等書。

translations.literal: Books he authored include ten collections of Great Accumulation, and also Records of Learning the Changes, Collection of Bearing the Way, Outer Chapters on Observing Things, and other books.
translations.idiomatic: Books he authored include ten collections of Great Accumulation, and also Records of Learning the Changes, Collection of Bearing the Way, Outer Chapters on Observing Things, and other books.

sentences.zh: ○陳思濟

translations.literal: ○ Chen Siji
translations.idiomatic: Chen Siji

sentences.zh: 陳思濟，字濟民，柘城人也。

translations.literal: Chen Siji, styled Jimin, was a man of Zhecheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Siji, styled Jimin, was a native of Zhecheng.

sentences.zh: 幼讀書，即曉大義，以才器見稱於時輩間。

translations.literal: From youth when he read books he immediately understood great principles; for talent and capacity he was praised among his contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: From youth when he read books he immediately understood great principles; for talent and capacity he was praised among his contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 世祖在潛邸，聞其名，召之以備顧問；

translations.literal: When Kublai was in the princely establishment, he heard his name and summoned him to serve as adviser;
translations.idiomatic: When Kublai was in the princely establishment, he heard his name and summoned him to serve as adviser;

sentences.zh: 既即位，始建省部，​​俾掌敷奏。

translations.literal: after he ascended the throne and first established the secretariat and ministries, he had Siji manage memorial submissions.
translations.idiomatic: after he ascended the throne and first established the secretariat and ministries, he had Siji manage memorial submissions.

sentences.zh: 世祖以京兆為國重鎮，命廉希憲等行中書省於陝西。

translations.literal: Kublai, taking Jingzhao as a crucial stronghold of the state, ordered Lian Xixian and others to operate the Branch Secretariat in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai, taking Jingzhao as a crucial stronghold of the state, ordered Lian Xixian and others to operate the Branch Secretariat in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 思濟實與偕行，多所贊畫。

translations.literal: Siji actually went together with them and contributed much to planning.
translations.idiomatic: Siji actually went together with them and contributed much to planning.

sentences.zh: 中統三年，詔誅王文統，召廉希憲入中書，思濟還，仍掌敷奏。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong, an edict ordered the execution of Wang Wentong and summoned Lian Xixian into the Secretariat. Siji returned and still managed memorial submissions.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Zhongtong reign, an edict ordered the execution of Wang Wentong and summoned Lian Xixian into the Secretariat. Siji returned and still managed memorial submissions.

sentences.zh: 事無鉅細，悉就準繩，姚樞、許衡皆器重之。

translations.literal: Matters great and small all followed the standard measure; Yao Shu and Xu Heng both valued him highly.
translations.idiomatic: Matters great and small all followed the standard measure; Yao Shu and Xu Heng both valued him highly.

sentences.zh: 會阿合馬入省，恥其位在希憲左，每欲肆意而行，希憲守正不從。

translations.literal: When Ahmad entered the secretariat, he was ashamed that his position was to Lian Xixian's left and always wished to act as he pleased; Xixian upheld rectitude and would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: When Ahmad entered the secretariat, he was ashamed that his position was to Lian Xixian's left and always wished to act as he pleased; Xixian upheld rectitude and would not follow.

sentences.zh: 及希憲去位，省臣晨集，掾屬皆憚阿合馬，莫敢前。

translations.literal: When Xixian left his post, the secretariat officials gathered in the morning; the clerks all feared Ahmad and none dared go forward.
translations.idiomatic: When Xixian left his post, the secretariat officials gathered in the morning; the clerks all feared Ahmad and none dared go forward.

sentences.zh: 思濟獨先以文牘進，阿合馬輒於希憲位署押，思濟遽掩以手曰：「此非君相署位也。

translations.literal: Siji alone first advanced with the documents. Ahmad immediately signed and sealed at Xixian's seat. Siji quickly covered it with his hand and said: "This is not the lord counselor's seat for signing."
translations.idiomatic: Siji alone first advanced with the documents. Ahmad immediately signed and sealed at Xixian's seat. Siji quickly covered it with his hand and said, "This is not the lord counselor's seat for signing."

sentences.zh: 」阿合馬怒目視之，眾為之懼，思濟神色自若。

translations.literal: " Ahmad glared at him in anger; the crowd was fearful for him, but Siji's expression was calm as ever.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad glared at him in anger; the crowd was fearful for him, but Siji's expression was calm as ever.

sentences.zh: 除右司都事，從希憲行省山東，未幾召還。

translations.literal: He was appointed Chief Clerk of the Right Office, followed Xixian to operate the Branch Secretariat in Shandong, and before long was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Chief Clerk of the Right Office, followed Xixian to operate the Branch Secretariat in Shandong, and before long was recalled.

sentences.zh: 至元五年，分命中書省總百揆，御史臺正百官，一時黜陟登庸，憲章程式，多出其手。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan, when the Secretariat was ordered to oversee all government and the Censorate to rectify all officials, the dismissals, promotions, and appointments of the time, and the censorial regulations and forms, mostly came from his hand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign, when the Secretariat was ordered to oversee all government and the Censorate to rectify all officials, the dismissals, promotions, and appointments of the time, and the censorial regulations and forms, mostly came from his hand.

sentences.zh: 遷承務郎、同知高唐州事，以績最聞，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Gentleman-of-Service and Vice Prefect of Gaotang Prefecture; for outstanding performance he was appointed Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Gentleman-of-Service and Vice Prefect of Gaotang Prefecture; for outstanding performance he was appointed Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 時阿合馬立尚書省，權在中書右。

translations.literal: At the time Ahmad established the Ministry; its authority was to the right of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Ahmad established the Ministry; its authority was to the right of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 思濟與魏初等劾其不法，帝命近臣正之。

translations.literal: Siji together with Wei Chu and others impeached his lawlessness; the emperor ordered close ministers to rectify it.
translations.idiomatic: Siji together with Wei Chu and others impeached his lawlessness; the emperor ordered close ministers to rectify it.

sentences.zh: 御史各以次對，思濟獨厲聲曰：「御史言官也，非為辨訟設！

translations.literal: The censors each responded in turn; Siji alone said in a stern voice: "Censors are speaking officials—they are not established for arguing lawsuits!"
translations.idiomatic: The censors each responded in turn; Siji alone said in a stern voice, "Censors are speaking officials—they are not established for arguing lawsuits!"

sentences.zh: 」拂袖而出。

translations.literal: " He swept his sleeve and went out.
translations.idiomatic: He swept his sleeve and went out.

sentences.zh: 授奉訓大夫、知沁州，為政簡要，不務苛察。

translations.literal: He was granted Fengxun Doctor and appointed Prefect of Qin Prefecture. His governance was simple and essential; he did not pursue harsh scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted Fengxun Doctor and appointed Prefect of Qin Prefecture. His governance was simple and essential; he did not pursue harsh scrutiny.

sentences.zh: 遷中順大夫、同知紹興路總管府事，承檄讞獄。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Zhongshun Doctor and Vice Administrator of Shaoxing Circuit; he received an order to try cases.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Zhongshun Doctor and Vice Administrator of Shaoxing Circuit; he received an order to try cases.

sentences.zh: 桐廬有囚羸瘠將死，縱遣還家，候期來決，囚拜請曰：「聞公名久矣，若不早決，恐終不可保。

translations.literal: In Tonglu there was a prisoner emaciated and near death. He was released to go home, to return when the term came for judgment. The prisoner bowed and pleaded: "I have long heard your name. If judgment is not made early, I fear I ultimately cannot be preserved."
translations.idiomatic: In Tonglu there was a prisoner emaciated and near death. He was released to go home, to return when the term came for judgment. The prisoner bowed and pleaded, "I have long heard your name. If judgment is not made early, I fear I ultimately cannot be preserved."

sentences.zh: 」為閱其案而釋之。

translations.literal: " He reviewed the case and released him.
translations.idiomatic: He reviewed the case and released him.

sentences.zh: 轉同知兩浙都轉運司事，胥吏侵漁，民困於賦役，悉蠲除之。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Zhejiang Transport Commission. Clerks plundered and the people were distressed by levies and corvée; he abolished them all.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Zhejiang Transport Commission. Clerks plundered and the people were distressed by levies and corvée; he abolished them all.

sentences.zh: 調陝西漢中道提刑按察副使，丁母憂去官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for the Shaanxi Hanzhong Circuit and left office on mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Investigation of Crimes for the Shaanxi Hanzhong Circuit and left office on mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，加少中大夫、同知浙東道宣慰司事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, he was granted Lesser Zhong Doctor and made Vice Commissioner of the Zhedong Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, he was granted Lesser Zhong Doctor and made Vice Commissioner of the Zhedong Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 時浙西大水，民飢，浙東倉廩殷實，即轉輸以賑之，全活者眾，檄上中書，奏允之。

translations.literal: At the time western Zhejiang had great flood and the people were hungry; eastern Zhejiang's granaries were full. He immediately transported grain to relieve them; many were preserved alive. He reported to the Secretariat by dispatch; the memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: At the time western Zhejiang had great flood and the people were hungry; eastern Zhejiang's granaries were full. He immediately transported grain to relieve them; many were preserved alive. He reported to the Secretariat by dispatch; the memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 浙東复旱，禱於名山，雨大澍，民賴以蘇。

translations.literal: Eastern Zhejiang again had drought; he prayed at famous mountains and great rain fell; the people relied on this to recover.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Zhejiang again had drought; he prayed at famous mountains and great rain fell; the people relied on this to recover.

sentences.zh: 兩淮鹽課不敷，授嘉議大夫、兩淮都轉運使，姦弊盡革，商賈通行，歲課以足。

translations.literal: The salt revenue of the Two Huai was insufficient. He was granted Jiayi Doctor and Commissioner of the Two Huai Transport Commission; corruption was entirely reformed, merchants passed freely, and annual revenue was made sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: The salt revenue of the Two Huai was insufficient. He was granted Jiayi Doctor and Commissioner of the Two Huai Transport Commission; corruption was entirely reformed, merchants passed freely, and annual revenue was made sufficient.

sentences.zh: 擢嶺北湖南道肅政廉訪使，改池州路總管。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Commissioner for Rectifying Governance and Investigating Corruption of the Lingbei Hunan Circuit and changed to Chief Administrator of Chizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Commissioner for Rectifying Governance and Investigating Corruption of the Lingbei Hunan Circuit and changed to Chief Administrator of Chizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 江浙行省平章也速答兒威勢赫然，摘淘金戶三千，括民間田畝，檄下，力上章以止之。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Yesudar's power and prestige were dazzling. He conscripted three thousand gold-panning households and registered civilian fields. When the dispatch came down, Siji forcefully memorialized to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Yesudar's power and prestige were dazzling. He conscripted three thousand gold-panning households and registered civilian fields. When the dispatch came down, Siji forcefully memorialized to stop it.

sentences.zh: 累遷通議大夫、僉河南江北等處行中書省事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Tongyi Doctor and Commissioner of the Branch Secretariat of Henan, Jiangbei, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Tongyi Doctor and Commissioner of the Branch Secretariat of Henan, Jiangbei, and other places.

sentences.zh: 大德五年冬，以疾卒，年七十。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year of Dade, he died of illness, aged seventy.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year of the Dade reign, he died of illness, aged seventy.

sentences.zh: 贈正議大夫、吏部尚書、上輕車都尉，追封潁川郡侯，諡文肅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Zhengyi Doctor, Minister of Personnel, and Senior Commandant of Chariots, ennobled as Marquis of Yingchuan Commandery with the posthumous name Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Zhengyi Doctor, Minister of Personnel, and Senior Commandant of Chariots, ennobled as Marquis of Yingchuan Commandery with the posthumous name Wensu.

sentences.zh: 子誠襲，廕入官，拜監察御史、朝列大夫、僉廣西道肅政廉訪司事。

translations.literal: His son Chengxi inherited privilege, entered office by yin privilege, and was appointed Supervising Censor, Chaolie Doctor, and Commissioner of the Guangxi Commission for Rectifying Governance and Investigating Corruption.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chengxi inherited privilege, entered office by yin privilege, and was appointed Supervising Censor, Chaolie Doctor, and Commissioner of the Guangxi Commission for Rectifying Governance and Investigating Corruption.

sentences.zh: ○秦長​​卿

translations.literal: ○ Qin Zhangqing
translations.idiomatic: Qin Zhangqing

sentences.zh: 秦長卿，洛陽人也。

translations.literal: Qin Zhangqing was a man of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Zhangqing was a native of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 姿貌魁特，性倜儻，有大志。

translations.literal: His appearance was tall and imposing; his nature was free and unrestrained; he had great ambition.
translations.idiomatic: He was tall and imposing in appearance, free and unrestrained in nature, and had great ambition.

sentences.zh: 世祖在京兆潛籓，已聞其名，既即位，務收攬時才，以布衣徵至京師。

translations.literal: When Kublai was in the princely establishment at Jingzhao, he had already heard his name. After ascending the throne, striving to gather talent of the age, he was summoned to the capital as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: When Kublai was in the princely establishment at Jingzhao, he had already heard his name. After ascending the throne, striving to gather talent of the age, he was summoned to the capital as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 長卿尚風節，好論事，與劉宣同在宿衛，以氣岸相高。

translations.literal: Zhangqing valued integrity and bearing, loved to discuss affairs, and together with Liu Xuan was in palace guard service, each holding the other's lofty spirit in esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangqing valued integrity and bearing, loved to discuss affairs, and together with Liu Xuan was in palace guard service, each holding the other's lofty spirit in esteem.

sentences.zh: 是時尚書省立，阿合馬專政，長卿上書曰：「臣愚贛，能識阿合馬，其為政擅生殺人，人畏憚之，固莫敢言，然怨毒亦已甚矣。

translations.literal: At that time the Ministry was established and Ahmad monopolized government. Zhangqing submitted a memorial: "Your subject is foolish and dull, yet can recognize Ahmad. In his governance he usurps the power of life and death; people fear and dread him, so none dare speak—but resentment and poison are already extreme."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Ministry was established and Ahmad monopolized government. Zhangqing submitted a memorial, "Your subject is foolish and dull, yet can recognize Ahmad. In his governance he usurps the power of life and death; people fear and dread him, so none dare speak—but resentment and poison are already extreme."

sentences.zh: 觀其禁絕異議，杜塞忠言，其情似秦趙高；

translations.literal: Observing how he forbids dissent and blocks loyal words, his disposition resembles Qin dynasty's Zhao Gao;
translations.idiomatic: Observing how he forbids dissent and blocks loyal words, his disposition resembles Qin dynasty's Zhao Gao;

sentences.zh: 私蓄逾公家貲，覬覦非望，其事似漢董卓。

translations.literal: his private accumulation exceeds public wealth and he covets what he should not hope for—his conduct resembles Han dynasty's Dong Zhuo.
translations.idiomatic: his private accumulation exceeds public wealth and he covets what he should not hope for—his conduct resembles Han dynasty's Dong Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 《春秋》人臣無將，請及其未發，誅之為便。

translations.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals says a minister must not have rebellious intent—please, before it erupts, execute him; that would be convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals says a minister must not have rebellious intent—please, before it erupts, execute him; that would be convenient.

sentences.zh: 」事下中書。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 阿合馬為人便佞，善伺人主意，又其貲足以動人，中貴人力為救解，事遂寢，然由是大恨長卿。

translations.literal: Ahmad was a man of smooth flattery, skilled at observing others' intentions; moreover his wealth was sufficient to move people. Inner court eunuchs exerted themselves to save and exonerate him; the matter was then dropped—but from this he greatly hated Zhangqing.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad was a man of smooth flattery, skilled at observing others' intentions; moreover his wealth was sufficient to move people. Inner court eunuchs exerted themselves to save and exonerate him; the matter was then dropped—but from this he greatly hated Zhangqing.

sentences.zh: 除興和宣德同知鐵冶事，竟誣以折閱課額數万緡，逮長卿下吏，籍其家產償官，又使獄吏殺之。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Commissioner of Iron Smelting for Xinghe and Xunde, but was ultimately falsely accused of reducing revenue quotas by tens of thousands of strings; Zhangqing was arrested and handed to officials, his family property registered to compensate the state, and prison officers were made to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Commissioner of Iron Smelting for Xinghe and Xunde, but was ultimately falsely accused of reducing revenue quotas by tens of thousands of strings; Zhangqing was arrested and handed to officials, his family property registered to compensate the state, and prison officers were made to kill him.

sentences.zh: 獄吏濡紙塞其口鼻，即死。

translations.literal: The prison officer soaked paper and stuffed his mouth and nose; he immediately died.
translations.idiomatic: The prison officer soaked paper and stuffed his mouth and nose; he immediately died.

sentences.zh: 未幾，王著聚徒殺阿合馬。

translations.literal: Before long Wang Zhu gathered followers and killed Ahmad.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Wang Zhu gathered followers and killed Ahmad.

sentences.zh: 帝后悟，亦追罪之，斬棺戮屍，並誅其子，而長卿冤終不白。

translations.literal: The emperor and empress came to understand and also pursued punishment against him—breaking the coffin and dismembering the corpse, and executing his sons as well—but Zhangqing's injustice was never cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and empress came to understand and also pursued punishment against him—breaking the coffin and dismembering the corpse, and executing his sons as well—but Zhangqing's injustice was never cleared.

sentences.zh: 長卿從子山甫，為建康府判官，聞長卿冤狀，即日棄官去，累薦不起以卒。

translations.literal: Zhangqing's nephew Shanfu was an assistant administrator of Jiankang Prefecture. Hearing of Zhangqing's unjust case, he immediately abandoned office and left; repeatedly recommended, he never took office and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangqing's nephew Shanfu was an assistant administrator of Jiankang Prefecture. Hearing of Zhangqing's unjust case, he immediately abandoned office and left; repeatedly recommended, he never took office and died.

sentences.zh: 山甫子從龍，仕至南台治書侍御史；

translations.literal: Shanfu's son Conglong served up to Investigating Censor of the Southern Branch Secretariat;
